features.as_of_rule: For each admitted ETF and the SPY reference, r(i,t)=C(i,t)/O(i,t)-1 from the complete regular session t. Use first regular-minute open and final regular-minute close, including XNYS early-close sessions. Known only at the regular close t; no next-open data enters a decision.
features.name: intraday_return

features.as_of_rule: Only OHLC panel inputs. For decision t use exactly the preceding 126 complete XNYS sessions [t-126,t-1]. Fit OLS with intercept r(i,s)=alpha(i,t)+beta(i,t)*r(SPY,s)+error(s). beta=sum((x-mean(x))*(y-mean(y)))/sum((x-mean(x))^2), alpha=mean(y)-beta*mean(x); sigma=sqrt(sum(error^2)/(126-2)). z(i,t)=(r(i,t)-alpha-beta*r(SPY,t))/sigma. No clipping, optimization, percentile fitting, later observations or current-session residual in sigma; never use current-basis corporate-action factors as features.
features.name: prior_market_beta_and_residual_scale
